ACQUISITION: REACH VS OBSERVED CONVERSION | G3-G6
+-- Expand (2018-Q1 2020): brand experiment
|   +-- [S] About $30M planned in 2019; payoff expected 2020+.
|   +-- [S] Test-market unaided awareness nearly doubled.
|   +-- [S] Similar control markets showed minimal increase.
|   +-- [S] Traffic increased; conversion impact remained unknown.
|   `-- [S] Q1 2020: campaign suspended for nearer-term priorities.
|       awareness -[untestable]-> paid conversion
+-- Reckoning -> Focused compounding: performance marketing
|   +-- [S] Q3 2022: tools rebuilt and payback guardrails tightened.
|   +-- [S] To Q1 2024: core performance acquisition +180%.
|   +-- [S] CAC improved almost 60% over the same comparison.
|   `-- [I] Reset baseline; not a platform-wide acquisition series.
+-- Base disclosure and onboarding
|   +-- [I] Net adds: 249k / 680k / 314k for 2019 / 2020 / 2021.
|   |   `-- [I] Endpoint differences, not gross adds or churn.
|   +-- [S] Large brands count as one merchant despite larger GMV.
|   +-- [S] Q3 2026: first-time sellers 7x since 2018.
|   +-- [S] In 2025, 43% more stores sold on signup day vs 2022.
|   `-- [I] Counts lack denominators; no conversion-rate inference.
+-- Interpretation boundary
    [I] Awareness controls do not establish downstream causality.
    [I] Seed's 18-month limit and 40% overseas spend lack excerpts.
